title: Modelling suicide ideation from beep to beep: Application of network analysis to ecological momentary assessment data
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Sample only consists of patients with Major Depression; - Sample only consists of inpatients, slightly diminishing ecological validity; - Important risk factors like defeat and entrapment were not included; - Self-report data only, not objective measures; - Sampling strategy might not capture natural course of SI; - Underpowered to detect subtle dynamic relations; - Networks should only be interpreted as potential causal relationships, not proven causality.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are available. The authors mention that the data were collected from the AMBAS study, but do not provide a link to supplementary materials or data repositories. The paper was not found to be preregistered. The authors used R and mlVAR for estimation and qgraph for visualization, but did not report using any specific statistical tests for centrality comparisons.
